title: Evaluating Language Models for Generating and Judging Programming Feedback

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of affirmative ('yes') predictions when models judge programming feedback without ground truth reference answers, revealing a tendency for models to be overly positive and overestimate the quality of the feedback.

Comparing language models' performance when evaluating their own generated programming feedback versus feedback generated by other models to identify a bias toward positive evaluations for outputs from the same model family.
